findings.title: Activity badges lose their text
findings.problem: Workflow, Exhibit and Condition resolved inherit ivory text on opaque pastel backgrounds.
findings.proposal: Use paired semantic foreground/background tokens for each activity kind; retain icon and text labels.
findings.acceptance: All normal badge text ≥4.5:1 in both themes; check all activity kinds.
findings.reproduction: Manager dashboard: inspect recent activity kind badges.
findings.rootCause: Workflow, Exhibit and Condition resolved inherit ivory text on opaque pastel backgrounds.

findings.title: Backup storage text nearly disappears
findings.problem: A fixed #f5f7ee panel bypasses dark surfaces while inheriting ivory foreground. Diagnostics become unreadable.
findings.proposal: Replace panel literal with a semantic surface; keep warning, diagnostic and unavailable states separately paired.
findings.acceptance: Heading and metadata ≥4.5:1 unless large; test unavailable, loading, success and error states.
findings.reproduction: Server administrator: Server Management → Backup storage, unavailable diagnostic state.
findings.rootCause: A fixed #f5f7ee panel bypasses dark surfaces while inheriting ivory foreground. Diagnostics become unreadable.

findings.title: Primary action labels miss normal-text contrast
findings.problem: Primary actions use near-white labels on #4f8a5d. At ordinary button sizes the measured 4.02:1 falls below 4.5:1. This repeats across queue, dashboard and server actions.
findings.proposal: Separate action background from accent foreground; use a darker green action fill with light text.
findings.acceptance: Every enabled primary action label ≥4.5:1; preserve hover, pressed and disabled distinctions.
findings.reproduction: Shared-controls static fixture or any enabled primary action in Care Queue.
findings.rootCause: Primary actions use near-white labels on #4f8a5d. At ordinary button sizes the measured 4.02:1 falls below 4.5:1. This repeats across queue, dashboard and server actions.

findings.title: Secondary approval actions have low contrast
findings.problem: Edit then Accept uses ivory normal text on a medium sage background.
findings.proposal: Use a dedicated secondary action role or outlined action with compliant text.
findings.acceptance: Normal action text ≥4.5:1; primary, secondary and destructive actions remain distinguishable.
findings.reproduction: Server administrator: AI Curator → review pending suggestion → Edit then Accept.
findings.rootCause: Edit then Accept uses ivory normal text on a medium sage background.

findings.title: Overdue care badge is difficult to read
findings.problem: A fixed brown-red foreground sits over a translucent tinted background. Ancestor-composited estimate is 1.06:1; use the painted-measurements file for a localized actual-pixel cross-check.
findings.proposal: Use paired warning or overdue tokens and retain the overdue count and text.
findings.acceptance: Validate ≥4.5:1 at actual rendered backgrounds in both themes; never rely on hue alone.

measurement.status: Gradient/compositing estimate; localized painted sample supplemental

findings.reproduction: Care Queue with overdue fixture tasks: location header overdue badge.
findings.rootCause: A fixed brown-red foreground sits over a translucent tinted background. Ancestor-composited estimate is 1.06:1; use the painted-measurements file for a localized actual-pixel cross-check.

findings.title: Care group metadata sits on a washed surface
findings.problem: White-opacity layers brighten the location header while muted text remains relatively dim. Estimated metadata contrast is 2.82:1.
findings.proposal: Give grouped headers an explicit dark surface and secondary text pair.
findings.acceptance: Location codes and group counts ≥4.5:1; nested groups remain distinct without a bright gray slab.
findings.reproduction: Care Queue grouped by location: inspect location code under group heading.
findings.rootCause: White-opacity layers brighten the location header while muted text remains relatively dim. Estimated metadata contrast is 2.82:1.

findings.title: AI review color roles are inconsistent
findings.problem: Green/amber utility combinations and opacity variants are not consistently covered by the compatibility layer. Proposed and current sections vary in brightness and hierarchy. Some computed candidates require painted validation.
findings.proposal: Use shared status, comparison-current and comparison-proposed roles; preserve Changed and Can apply text.
findings.acceptance: Review pending, approved, rejected, blocked and stale states; text and icons carry meaning; remeasure all variants.

measurement.status: Candidate only; gradients and opacity prevent blanket pass/fail

findings.reproduction: AI Curator pending review, status panels and proposed/current comparison.
findings.rootCause: Green/amber utility combinations and opacity variants are not consistently covered by the compatibility layer. Proposed and current sections vary in brightness and hierarchy. Some computed candidates require painted validation.

findings.title: Keyboard focus needs an explicit theme role
findings.source: components/ui.tsx; app/globals.css: focus and compatibility rules
findings.problem: Focused email field reports transparent outline and only an inset shadow; inherited border overrides make the intended focus treatment hard to distinguish. This is a focus design finding, not a quantified WCAG violation.
findings.proposal: Apply a visible opaque focus outline with offset and retain it in dark and light themes.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard-only review of links, fields, buttons, dialogs and menus; compare focused/unfocused states and measure non-text contrast at the indicator.

measurement.status: Observed computed style; no claimed indicator contrast ratio

findings.reproduction: Anonymous login: keyboard-focus email field without submitting.
findings.rootCause: Focused email field reports transparent outline and only an inset shadow; inherited border overrides make the intended focus treatment hard to distinguish. This is a focus design finding, not a quantified WCAG violation.

findings.title: Theme compatibility selectors are fragile
findings.problem: Large literal-color compatibility lists with !important cannot reliably cover every neutral family, opacity variant and new module. Source candidates are not automatically visible defects.
findings.proposal: Introduce semantic surface, field, action, status, chart and focus roles; migrate shared components first and retire compatibility mappings incrementally.
findings.acceptance: No new page-specific light literal without an intentional documented exception; regression gallery covers both themes and real conditional states.
findings.reproduction: Inspect source inventory and compare current grid, expanded instance and dialog captures.
findings.rootCause: Large literal-color compatibility lists with !important cannot reliably cover every neutral family, opacity variant and new module. Source candidates are not automatically visible defects.

findings.title: Choose the desired dark-mode character
findings.problem: Existing warm olive treatment is coherent in places, but layered translucency makes surface hierarchy variable. This is a design choice independent of accessibility repairs.
findings.proposal: Compare A refined existing, B botanical charcoal and C neutral charcoal. Recommend B as the starting direction, subject to owner review.
findings.acceptance: Approve a direction separately from individual fixes; verify all semantic palettes, print and intentionally light pages after implementation.
findings.reproduction: Compare A/B/C in the review report using dashboard, grid and queue scenes.
findings.rootCause: Existing warm olive treatment is coherent in places, but layered translucency makes surface hierarchy variable. This is a design choice independent of accessibility repairs.
